name: Kiro
desc: AWS spec-driven agentic IDE built on Code OSS
desc_zh: AWS 出品的规格驱动（spec-driven）Agentic IDE，基于 Code OSS
solves: Agents start editing code before anyone agrees what to build. It begins from a written spec, so intent is settled first.
solves_zh: Agent 常常在需求还没对齐时就开始改代码。它先从一份写下来的规格开始，把意图先谈定。
best_for: When you want an agent to build features from a specification you agreed on first.
best_for_zh: 想让 Agent 照着事先谈定的规格来做功能的时候。
